explanation: It is the only one of the twelve signs shown by an object rather than a living being. Libra is Latin for 'scales', which is also why pounds are written 'lb'.

claims.text: In the Western zodiac, Libra is represented by a pair of scales.
Virgo, Gemini and Aquarius are represented by a maiden, twins and a water-bearer, not by scales.
Libra is the only one of the 12 signs of the Western zodiac represented by an inanimate object.
The abbreviation 'lb' for the pound weight comes from the Latin libra.
